can you fix 

wscbor.c:357:11: warning: empty paragraph passed to '@return' command [-Wdocument

and also 
packet-bpv7.c:1029:17: warning: Value stored to 'item_crc_type' during its initialization is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
packet-bpv7.c:1193:17: warning: Value stored to 'item_crc_type' during its initialization is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]

The `item_crc_type` ones are actually a compiler optimization due to a cast to `BundleCrcType` that is fine when the dissected value is valid but can fail when it's out of spec. Removing the cast and changing the stored type will have the value properly represented.

commits_data.title: BPv7: Enhance block data and payload data handling
commits_data.message:
BPv7: Enhance block data and payload data handling

This change improves sequence analysis and subdissector interfaces, adds
payload Decode As support for DTN and IPN services, and add heuristic
dissection for BTSD.
